timeline: You might assume fierce desert winds push heavy stones across Racetrack Playa, but what actually moves a 700-pound boulder?
Massive rocks leave long carved tracks in the dry mud.
No animals pull them across the desert basin.
For decades, scientists argued about winter winds pushing them.
Then time-lapse cameras solved the bizarre mystery.
Thin sheets of floating winter ice trap the boulders.
Gentle desert breezes push the ice panels forward.
The ice acts like a massive sailing ship.
Ice and wind make heavy stones walk.
